interface.longDescription: TavernWeave 1.6.0: 22 skills add editable work libraries from novels, fanwork, researched text and inspected image references, with source citations, canon/fanon and stage filters, resumable batches and SQLite export. Shared plain language and user-selected 新人/入门/熟练/老手 guidance remain available. Host rediscovery and real-work token evaluation remain separate checks.
